q01.question: Reflecting on your weather.py, which of the following statements is true (choose all that apply).

responses.inputstring: The ZIPCODE command line argument is sent to the server as the value of the inputstring parameter in the HTTP request.
responses.multiple: Multiple HTTP requests must be made to extract the temperature and forecast information.
responses.separate: Extracting the Celsius and Fahrenheit temperatures requires two separate regular expressions.
responses.unescape: To translate ° into °, you can use html.unescape.

q02.question: Reflecting on your campus.py, which of the following statements is true (choose all that apply).

responses.name: The NAME command line argument is sent to the server as the value of the name parameter in the HTTP request.
responses.sub: To find and replace patterns in the clean_description function, you can use re.sub.
responses.json: We must use json.loads on the Response object to convert the text into Python objects.
responses.match_all: To tell the HTTP server to match all tags, we must set the match_all_tags parameter to "1".

Note: For each of these, enter in the count.

  1. Count the number of words that end with the letters "est". ____

    abbest
abdest
ablest
abruptest
absolutest
...

  2. Ignoring case, count the number of words that start with the letter "j". ____

    ...
Jynginae
jyngine
Jynx
jynx

    ...
zoeae
zoeal
zoeas
zooid
zuian

zaffar
